label: Custard
note: The egg proteins set at about 70 °C, so milk and egg yolk thicken with no starch. Two or three degrees too much and it curdles. Thin pouring custard, thick pastry cream and the set desserts are all this step.

about.text: A sweet milk or cream cooked with egg or egg yolk until it thickens or sets. It runs from a thin pouring sauce (crème anglaise) to thick pastry cream and to desserts that set whole, such as crème caramel.
